comparison.objective: Enclose a knife and fork by rolling them in a cloth napkin; not separate retained parts from media.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-cloth edge acquisition, wrapping, regrasping, and containment of cutlery.
comparison.success_condition: Specified napkin winding and coverage around aligned cutlery, released on the table; versions use different final dwell/scoring tiers.
comparison.reason: Although both manage multiple loose items, this tests deformable wrapping and joint containment, the opposite of aperture-based separation.
